value.rationale: Quantitative sharp complete classification on a natural four-Bell-projection two-qubit slice of the separability cone, a meaningful extension of qualitative operator-mean rigidity. Exact global negativity ceiling and extremizer hold for all normalized Kubo–Ando means, with a surprising endpoint-atom-only dependence and a strict full-rank attainment boundary.
